edits_summary: Removed import { isRunningOnMac } from '@/utils/platform' (was line 7) -- no longer used after collapsing branch
Removed const WEB_TABLET_MAX_WIDTH_CAP = 800 (was line 15) and its 1-line comment (line 14)
Removed if (isRunningOnMac()) { return available; } branch (was lines 39-41) -- web/tablet path now matches Mac path
Removed Math.min(available, WEB_TABLET_MAX_WIDTH_CAP) clamp (was line 42); replaced with single return Math.max(0, windowWidth - leftDrawerWidth - rightSidebarWidth) at the function tail
Added 5-line comment block documenting the Cycle 6 BA spec reference (dev-20260425-201355-5-4-5) and user directive in spec-20260424-084848.md §7
Updated JSDoc on useHeaderMaxWidth() to remove stale 'Web/tablet caps at 800 as before' line; replaced with 'No upper cap is applied on any platform'
rationale: Cycle 1 commit 0ba2ddfc made the header max-width calculation reactive but preserved the legacy 800px cap as WEB_TABLET_MAX_WIDTH_CAP, so on viewports >= ~880px the cap dominated and avatar.right stayed at 1526 (394px short of 1920 viewport edge). Both sidebar-open and sidebar-closed states clamped to 800, masking toggle effects and producing the §5.5 'inverted toggle / clustering' symptom. Per BA spec dev-20260425-201355-5-4-5 (L3 fix authorized by user directive in spec-20260424-084848.md §7 Correction line 2883-2887), the cap is removed entirely so the existing reactive formula (windowWidth - leftDrawer - rightSidebar) drives layout. Single-file change (15 lines net diff). No new constants introduced. Math.max(0, ...) safety-clamp guard preserved. RIGHT_SIDEBAR_WIDTH=450 and RIGHT_SIDEBAR_DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH=901 preserved (real layout constants per BA spec exclusions). Header.tsx and ChatHeaderView.tsx consumers verified to take the hook's return value via maxWidth: headerMaxWidth -- no consumer-side changes needed.
type_check_notes: yarn typecheck in packages/happy-app/ exits with pre-existing errors in unrelated files (SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx, SidebarNavigator.tsx, SidebarAgentConversation.tsx, SidebarFileView.tsx). None of the errors reference useHeaderMaxWidth.ts or isRunningOnMac. grep confirms zero new typecheck issues from this change. The pre-existing SidebarNavigator.tsx 'sidebarCollapsed' as any error was already documented in the original useHeaderMaxWidth.ts comment (line 60-62 of new file).
